input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full. 24.1 gives Customer an unconditional right to assign to an Affiliate (as defined in 1.1) or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or asset sale without Vendor consent, subject only to prompt notice and assignee assumption. 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance and indirect transfer by change of control to Customer's prior written consent (reasonableness-qualified) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. 24.3's residual consent requirement is expressly limited to "other assignments," so it does not swallow the 24.1 carve-out. 24.4 confirms Customer's change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, and 13.3 tracks Section 24 by allowing licence transfer to an Affiliate or successor on a permitted assignment. No other provision (including the insolvency termination right in 9.2, which excludes non-impairing reorganizations) creates a Vendor exit or re-pricing right on our change of control. No redline required.
